nom: COSRX Hyaluronic Acid Hydra Power Essence

avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive dry acne prone skin and every serum seems to be too harsh or will break me out due to extra additive ingredients. Right away it felt soothing and hydrating. It has a tacky feel when drying. Will continue using!

One of my most fav HA. I have tried LRP one. But this one is amazing. Helps clear my skin. Deeply hyrdrates. Repaired my damaged barrier. Has no actives..:. Recommend for all sensitive reactive barrier skin..

I have dry, dehydrated skin that is super easily irritated thanks to rosacea. I've tried soooo many products and most of them cause a flareup or just don't work, but this is incredible! The first time I used it, my skin felt plump, hydrated, and very happy. I've never seen such instant results and I can't remember the last time my skin felt so smooth. If you have dehydrated, sensitive skin, try this!

The Cosrx hydra power essence is hydrating, fragrance-free, and feels slightly thick on the skin but not sticky. I apply it on damp skin so that the hyaluronic acid absorbs the water and then I use moisturizer to keep my skin from drying out.

avis.titre: Great skincare addition for acne prone skin!
avis.texte: My skin in extremely acne prone and very dry. There are very few moisturizers I can use so I was looking for something lightweight and noncomedogenic to add more moisture to my skin, leading me here! Has not broken me out, has added moisture into my skin, does not irritate my sensative skin and plumped my skin! Everyone's skin is different but with such limited ingredients (therfore limited possibilities for reactions) I would say it's worth trying!!

After seeing the rave reviews from the dermatologist online I thought I'd try one of their products and I'm glad I did. I use this before moisturizing my face and neck and it immediately softens my skin. Once I put my night cream on and it settles in my face feels silky soft. I'm glad I switched.

Before I used this serum I had extremely dry, irritated skin under my eyes and fine lines on my forehead. After using this serum every night, my skin is glowing. The dry patches and fine lines are gone.

After toning, I mix 1-2 pumps of this with the 6 Peptide Booster & I love it! The 6 Peptide Booster is too watery for me and this Hyluranic Acid Hydra Power is too sticky/thick so when I mix them I get the perfect consistency! And it's great prep for my treatments and moisturizer after! I have very dry, red, irritated skin and this helped alot!

avis.titre: Worth it - not like other products!!
avis.texte: I have super dry skin that is prone to hormonal acne & clogged pores and I have tried countless hydrating serums that all feel like they do nothing or just sit on top of the skin but this one genuinely changes the feel of my skin. It is deeply hydrating and makes my skin feel so smooth, I use it day and night under other products. Also it has no pore clogging ingredients!

This product is thin and almost watery which allows it to absorb super fast into the skin. I apply before bed and wake up to smooth skin. I alternate with prescription azelaic acid and they seem to work well alternating days. Skin is way softer after using.
I have been using this for almost a year now & on my second bottle. My skin is so hydrated & glowing! Its lightweight & overall just amazing!!

I have very sensitive, dry combination skin. I honestly really love this product. It gives my skin so much hydration and goes very well with my moisturizer. I also use the hydrium toner from this brand before the essence, and my skin has never felt better. So hydrated with no dry patches. Definitely safe for sensitive skin, it's very gentle and absorbs nicely. I can see a difference in the size of my pores, and the overall tone of my skin. This is not a strong product, simply just for hydration. If you're getting a bad reaction you probably aren't using correctly, or you're overworking your skin.
47 year old skin loves this serum. I have dry skin and this serum is the bomb. Run and get this now.

I use this under my moisturizer before bed and I wake up with glowing beautiful skin. Zero irritation & it feels very pure. You only need a very small amount. People having poor reactions probably don't know how to treat their skin and protect the moisture barrier, using harsh stripping soaps etc. If you use too much, it might leave a sticky residue initially but it says you should gently tap with your fingers to help it absorb. Ideally it should be used after washing your face when there is the most moisture to lock it in. Highly recommend. Normal/combo skin.

So this may be an odd review but I'm not sure if this works? As in, I don't think it's helping but it's definitely not hurting anything… I have very oily ACNE prone skin which usually consist of cystic pimples. This doesn't break me out at all and there's no scent so that's amazing. I'm just not sure it's doing anything? I have continued to use it since I'm not good at returning items. It's been about 1-2 months now of night time use.
this product didn't work for me :/ it became sticky when it dried down like maple syrup or honey type sticky. very uncomfortable & disappointed with this product 😓
I use this every night when my skin is still damp and whenever i feel dry in the mornings. It makes me feel so soft & hydrated, and look so glowy!!

When I first applied this product it felt gooey then when my skin absorbed it it left my skin 10% sticky which was annoying but manageable. My skin felt tingley, but I still wanted to give it a try. For the next few days I notice that my skin looked more hydrated and more plump. Which I loved, but now I've developed a bunch of small white pimples on my face. This is the only new product that I've tested in almost a week. I want to love this product be its definitely not for sensitive skin. I did let my 9 year old try it and it did wonders to her skin. My daughter has normal skin. I'm 31 with sensitive acne prone skin for reference.

I've been using this daily product for close to 6 months. It has completely changed the overall appearance (hydration) of my skin. In addition to hydration, it makes my skin soft and soothes it after a sunny day.

avis.titre: Feels Like Silk on My Skin!
avis.texte: Definitely a great product! Goes on super silky and leaves no residue. I highly recommend this product if you can get your hands on it! It took me about a year to find some in stock in store

I have dry,dehydrated skin and I have tried ALMOST EVERYTHING. When I used this in my night routine, took a shower, clean damp face , then this, topped it off with moisturizer and my occlusive. When I woke up my skin felt so much better than it usually feels in the morning. I wasn't extremely dry and didn't feel like my skin was going to crack! This is the only thing new I added to this routine. No small pimples or anything ☺️So far so good!

I have dry,dehydrated skin and I have tried ALMOST EVERYTHING. When I used this in my night routine, took a shower, clean damp face , then this, topped it off with moisturizer and my occlusive. When I woke up my skin felt so much better than it usually feels in the morning. I wasn't extremely dry and didn't feel like my skin was going to crack! This is the only thing new I added to this routine. No small pimples or anything ☺️So far so good!

Haven't noticed much of a difference in my skin yet, but I love how hydrating it feels on my skin though. I've tried so many different hyaluronic acid's (the ordinary, good molecules, la roche posay) so hopefully this one sticks.
I have been repurchasing for over a year! SO moisturizing & nourishing & lasts forever even though I use it morning+night.

avis.titre: Perfection for Sensitive Dry Eczema Skin!
avis.texte: I apply this right after a toning hydration mist and your skin is instantly quenched! Not sticky at all and I love how moisturizing it is for my skin. I find this to be way better than Plump Jelly by Moon Juice - I stopped using this once staple in my routine due to the high fragrance content… not to mention, CosRX is more affordable! I never leave reviews, but I wanted to say TY to the original poster who also has sensitive dry eczema skin like me. Because of their post, I took a chance on this and it was PERFECTION! Wanted to boost this for others with our skin types.

I've bought this stuff for years & even tho i like to experiment with new products i always go back to this for the glass skin of my dreams. I don't use toners or anything prior but like most HA products it works the best if you apply to damp skin. ive been able to recommend it to multiple friends & SOs with a variety of skin issues & no one ever has a bad reaction.
Hydrated my skin and also made my face soft with a small glow look

I've tried countless moisturizers to remedy my dry skin and never used HA before. This is the first HA product I use and man, it's changed my skin forever. It has a slight tacky feeling, but nothing that stays after you moisturize. This product truly plumps and moisturizes my skin and I will never go back! This is a lifesaver and honestly, it's so good I couldn't stop touching my face at first. 😅 Also, I tried this brand because The Welsh brothers, Robert and James, showed it on one of their skincare videos.

I hadn't heard of this brand until I stumbled upon it at an Ulta store. Wow! Worth it. It's not at all tacky like some other brands and noticeably hydrated the skin. It's easy to put other products over or under it and makeup sits well over it.
I love this serum. You get a large amount of product for the price, lasts forever and I use it twice a day. very effective as a base under moisturizer for and extra supple hydration boost.

Been using this product for a year and I love it. I put it on after my shower every morning while my face is still wet. Rub it in and then apply a moisturizer. It got rid of all my smile lines around my eyes and mouth. I recommend to everyone!

I have pretty oily skin and I read that this is often because your skin is dehydrated. I picked this up on a recommendation and not really sure what to expect. I first used only this product at night in order to "reset" my skin and build back my moisture barrier. I definitely noticed less oil production throughout the day when normally my forehead would be slick. Now, I mostly use it if I've exfoliated too much, on days I drink (bring back that moisture) or just more calm days. I wake up seeing a difference in my skin hydration, smoothness. This is my second time repurchasing - the product lasts a long time and a little goes a long way.

If you are looking for a good/great hyaluronic acid serum for a great price and size, this is the product. is for you. Very moisturizing compared to other the Glow Recipe Plum Plump serum. My first time using the brand. I will buy again and try other products! I have already recommended this product to all my friends and family

I've been using this about a month or so and I'm mot noticing any major difference. The texture is slimy but the thing that bothers me about this product is that it turns white if you use too much and seems to like, foam up on the skin? I have no idea why it's doing this but it takes forever to rub in if you use too much. I'm going to explore other brands after it's gone

I've tried The Ordinary's HA, Inkey List HA, Good Molecules HA and this one. Out of all them, my favorite one is the Inkey List HA, it's just so much more hydrating. This one in particular was okay, I even paired it with the snail mucin and honestly my skin doesn't feel as plump as when I used the Inkey List HA.

avis.titre: Perfect for dry, sensitive, eczema prone skin
avis.texte: I have super dry, sensitive skin because my skin's barrier is weak due to mild eczema. There are so many products I am not able to use ... anything with fragrance , alcohol , grape seed oil, lanolin , essential oils, etc. This is the holy grail for my skin. It locks in moisture and doesn't irritate my skin at all. I've tried so many skincare products and I know that this is the one item I will keep on re-purchasing for life.
CosRX has the best Hylauronic acid essence! It doesn't leave your skin sticky as others can. It just keeps your skin moist and plump, perfect for under moisturizer!

when you do the math, this and the ordinary are the same price. but this one is thinner and therefore not as hydrating on my dry, acne prone skin. it feels like water and after I apply it, it doesnt feel like I added a serum or much hydration at all. honestly, it actually left my skin looking dull. I know this isnt supposed to be like a moisturizer but in the end The Ordinary's was superior because it was more slimy (but dries like nothing is on your face) and seemed to lock in more moisture and the vitamin seems to give my face life. so try this if you dont like the feeling of stuff of your face, but there really isnt much moisture.

I saw a difference the day after using this product! My skin felt SO soft, hydrated, and plump the day after I used this for the first time. I use a lot of serums and oils at night and normally wake up with my face being a little oily, but, once I started using this essence my face is completely dry in the morning so I know it is making all of my products absorb into my skin better. This has now because one of my favorite products in my skin care regimen!

This feels good going on my skin. I have sensitive, acne prone skin so I was nervous about this clogging pores. It doesn't at all and I'm liking it so far although I'm not seeing results yet. It's still pretty early in the bottle though and I love the small ingredient list.

When I turned 40 and wearing facemasks all day at work (am in hsalthcare) I was developing creases that were staying around my nose and between my eyebrows and around my eyes. I also noticed wrinkles upon waking which was new the past few months (maybe stress and dry winter weather). I started using this and if was a lifesaver! I have combo skin so slathering thick creams was breaking me out but not getting rid of the creases and wrinkles. Only after I started using this essense (use after cleansing, toner, serum, then essense, but before moisturizer or sunscreens) did the fine lines plump up seemingly overnight. This gives more product that other "glassskin serums" or essenses for the price and I saw results quickly. I didnt break out with this at all and I have fairly sensitive skin with hormonal cystic acne.
I'm liking how this feels going on. It's too early to say if it's working yet.

I suffer from hormonal acne and have my whole life. I started using this product a year ago. Not only has it dramatically changed the way my skin feels it has helped clear up my break outs. My skin is so different now. I can't live without this stuff. It's amazing and a MUST have for everyone routine. Little tip put it on right out of the shower when ur face is still damp to lock in all the moisture.

I bought this bottle 6 months ago and I am now having to buy a new bottle. This makes my skin feel hydrated and soft, I am 42 and need all the help I can get. My skin feels amazing after applying this to my face, like my skin just took a drink of water.

avis.titre: One of the best I've tried so far!
avis.texte: I am loving this so far and I think it's better then The Ordinary. It doesn't feel sticky after use, it's spreads nicely on the skin. The best part is it doesn't break me out which happens when I use a new products. I highly recommend this!

Highly recommend for mature skin. I am 49 and this essence rocks and is comparable to higher end and more prestige essence products. Make sure you press into skin and use your serum(s) while skin is still damp from essence.

I've tried other hyaluronic serums but they always end up drying out my skin and/or breaking me out. This one doesn't irritate my skin and it definitely seems to make my skin look healthier and plumper. I have really hard water, so I use this as a toner after washing my face to get all that off and my skin has been so much more balanced. It's also a great buffer for chemical exfoliants.

I had been using the ordinary hyaluronic acid for months and didn't see much of a result. I got this and within a few days my skin felt baby smooth and the elasticity has even improved. It looks visibly healthier. One pump covers my whole face, so the bottle is going to last a long time. Super worth it!

Great ingredients! No fragrance and has Panthenol which will help pack a bigger punch with the hydration to your skin. Greatest tip you'll ever hear... when washing your face with a cleanser, DON'T dry your face of the water sitting on top of your face. Go in with the essence and immediately add your fragrance free moisturizer/spf. La Rosche posay has the best spfs as well as Cerave.. thank me later ;)

avis.titre: Difference after a week of use
avis.texte: I've only been using this product for about 2 weeks. I have been using it at night after double cleansing and before a moisturizer. It's been the only serum/extra product I've been using to really see how it works. I bought this product because I felt my skin was getting too dehydrated and I wanted to add some extra moisture. After a week of use I feel like my skin is clearer, brighter and smoother. My dark spots also seem to have lightened after regular use. My issues with dehydration aren't gone but I definitely feel like my skin is on the right path again.

I use my toner then the product then moisturize. I have recommended to many friends who have also found the product to be amazing and do wonders for their skin, leaves skin feeling fresh and moisturized.

avis.titre: I would buy again and again and again!
avis.texte: This moisturizer is so light and airy! Its the perfect amount for everyday use. I have run into many products that do not work for my skin and this line of products work perfectly for me!
I use it am and pm after toner and before serum, it plumps the skin make it soft and glowy
I'm in my late 30's this does wonders plumping those tiny little under eyes wrinkles to help create a flawless look. It's a staple and a great value, a little goes A LONG WAY!
Sinks in my skin lovely. Hydrates very well then I apply my moisturizer :)

I have super sensitive and dry/combo skin and this product enhances anything it touches and any other product you use it with. You can use it alone but I mix this at night with a Sea Buckthorn oil and it just sinks into the skin and creates a beautifully hydrated barrier. It doesn't irritate my skin and it lasts for a long time. Please try this! It's amazing.

I enjoyed the fact that it made my skin feel and look very moisturized without that fake greasy, sit on top of your skin/ mask feeling that mostly all skincare with dimethicone tend to do... But minutes after application, my face started feeling flushed/hot and got red/irritation so I sadly had to wash it off. Please consider making more natural products without synthetic ingredients. Maybe a goat milk essence? No oils/only HA/no irritating plant extracts only fruit and juice extracts like drunk elephants products

avis.titre: Double the hydration as than the snail mucin!!!
avis.texte: I bought this on a whim while looking for a new HA serum and I found a keeper!! It says essence but it's thick like a serum, not too thick but a little thicker than the snail mucin. If you like the snail mucin you'll love this as it feels much more hydrating. I use it after applying products right before my moisturizer and my skin stays soft all day and night and I use it twice a day

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: I just applied the product after I used a toner twice a day , and it has really made my skin look more soft and smooth , if you want to get rid of textured skin and minimize the look of pores ! Get this product ! I normally get really oily on my forehead so I skip using this product on my forehead because It does help to build up lotions and things up there .

I have dry dehydrated skin so hyaluronic acid is a must-have in my skincare routine but I've had a hard time finding one that works well enough without being super overpriced. Enter, COSRX. For the amount of product you get and how much you use this is such a great value and last loads longer than any of the other brands that only come in a 30 mL bottle. Use this in your routine after cleansing but before moisturizer since it's an essence (remember water based then oil based and go from thinest to thickest). Depending on how far I'm bringing it down my neck I only need 1-2 pumps max (and two really is just a bit too much). Pat it in until it gets tacky and then stop, you're done. This is such a great skincare line, so glad Ulta carries it!

I have been using cosrx products for years now. I use this essence morning and night everyday because its so lightweight and sinks into the skin almost instantly, yet provides me that little extra boost of moisture that my dry skin needs! I think this would be great for any skin type because of how lightweight it is.

This brand really is worth the hype. Everything I use makes my skin glowing, hydrated, and my pores are gone. This product in particular helps with plumping the skins surface and getting your skin prepped for your next steps. I use this with the AHA/BHA toner, the snail essence, and I follow up with the HA gel moisturizer and the all in one snail cream.

I apply one pump morning and evening along with my moisturizer. I LOVE it and will be buying other CosRX skin care products to go along with it. Thanks Dr. Dray for your review on tis skin care product.

i love this moisturizer so so so much! it's so light, absorbs so quickly, leaves your skin feeling smooth, soft, and plump, and (moist importantly for me) it's safe for fungal acne! i love that this doesn't have any fragrance or anything since my skin is so sensitive, and i really appreciate how this makes me glow. most moisturizers make me look kind of oily instead of hydrated, and they tend to feel greasy on the face, but this absorbs and feels like almost nothing

i love this moisturizer so so so much! it's so light, absorbs so quickly, leaves your skin feeling smooth, soft, and plump, and (moist importantly for me) it's safe for fungal acne! i love that this doesn't have any fragrance or anything since my skin is so sensitive, and i really appreciate how this makes me glow. most moisturizers make me look kind of oily instead of hydrated, and they tend to feel greasy on the face, but this absorbs and feels like almost nothing

I used to use Tula (religiously!) until I truly wanted to go CLEAN, which clean to me means no sulfates, fragrances, silicone, alcohol, fungal acne agents. This meets all my boxes. I can't tell you how much COSRX has changed my skin, I could literally cry. I've always had sensitive, irritable, red rosacea skin. Since using COSRX, my skin is actual skin color, NOT RED. To the person below saying they broke out "probably because of the fragrance". This has zero fragrance other than from Hippophae Rhamnoides Water, which is about as all natural as you can get. Give this a try, you will love it!
Broke me out instantly. Probably due to the fragrance ingredients.

I bought this on a whim and actually like it. I was skeptical at first but it seems to help my products I put on after soak in better. For the price and the amount you have to use each time (1 pump is definitely enough) I think it will last me a really long time.

I'm a hyaluronic acid stan, so I've tried my fair share of hits and misses in this category. I found the COSRX product to be a super effective product as well as enjoyable to use. The pump bottle dispenses a conservative amount of product, which is perfect because it's REALLY easy to over-apply HA and end up sticky. The essence itself is fairly thin in formula but packs a punch. I layer this on damp skin with other essences and serums, and I see a big difference between this and some other HA alternatives as far as plumpness and overall hydration. I will definitely repurchase!
I love this essence. It locks the moisture in and preps my skin for my serums.

I have used this product now for two weeks and I have noticed my skin is hydrated but not and oil slick. My pores have disappeared and my broken capillaries around my nose are gone. This is by far one the best products I have used in a long time. The price is awesome too. I wont ever be with out this product.
moisturizing but if I use to often it breaks my skin out. best for very dry skin

This is an amazingggg way to get hyaluronic acid in your skincare routine. It truly hydrates the skin and I can't go a day without it. I use two pumps in the morning after washing my face & before all other skincare products. I'm just now hitting half the bottle, it is lasting me really well. For the price you can't beat it and I will repurchase over and over now. It is a bit sticky, but use it before your moisturizer and other skincare products and you will be fine.

avis.titre: I Want to Bathe In It
avis.texte: I have fairly dry skin, and I was looking for something to give my skin just a little extra boost. Even when I just tried it in the store, I was impressed, especially with the very doable price. I've been using it for two weeks now, and I've noticed my skin is plumper and smoother than it's been in a while-maybe ever. All you need is one pump in the morning before you put on your spf moisturizer and one at night after you use your toner and before you moisturize, and your skin will thank you. It's seriously my favorite skin care product right now.

I've tried quite a few plumping serums over the last few years & so far this is the best. I use one pump on my fingertips with a few drops of water, then pat it in. Ordering COSRX skincare is now a no-brainer for me after also using and loving their Honey Ceramide cream, Honey Overnight mask, & Rice Overnight mask.

avis.titre: More of a serum than essence
avis.texte: Was looking for a good hydrating serum and this has been great! Nice simple ingredients that work. Thicker consistency than a traditional essence.

I've tried mannnny essences and usually they either irritate my extremely sensitive skin or are way too expensive. This is perfect, no irritation and adds a nice layer of hydration to my skin while not breaking the bank.
